data.fund_name: PGIM India Multi Asset Allocation Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended scheme investing in Equity and Equity related instruments, Debt & Money Market instruments, Gold ETFs &Silver ETFs
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation by investing in multiple assetclasses including equity and equity related securities, debt and money market instruments, Gold ETFs & Silver ETFs. However,there is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee/ indicateany returns.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related instruments (including Derivatives) - Min 30% and Max 70% Debt and money market instruments -Min 10% and Max 35% Gold ETFs & Silver ETFs - Min 10% and Max 25% Units issued by InvITs - Min 0% and Max 10%
data.benchmark: 60% of Nifty 500 TRI+ 20% of Crisil Short Term Bond Index + 10% of Domestic prices of Gold + 10% of Domestic prices of Silver
data.fund_managers: Mr. Vivek Sharma, Mr. Anandha Padmanabhan Anjeneyan, Mr. Utsav Mehta and Mr. Puneet Pal
data.exit_load: For Exits within 90 days from date of allotment of units: 0.50%; For Exits beyond 90 days from date of allotment of units: NIL.
